subject: general
question: If 2st January 2008 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 1st January 2012?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• No of days from 3 January 2008 to 1 January 2012 = 364 + 365 + 365 + 365 + 1 = 1460 as 2008 was a leap year.
 
• Since, it was Wednesday on 2 January 2008, every 7th day from 2 January will be a Wednesday.
